title: Red Hat Security Advisory: qt5-qtdeclarative security update
description: A security vulnerability (CVE-2025-12385) exists in the Qt5 QtDeclarative component affecting Red Hat Enterprise Linux 9.8 Extended Update Support. The flaw involves improper validation of the tag size in the Text component parser. Red Hat has released an important security update addressing this issue for multiple architectures and product variants. The vulnerability is rated as having a high severity impact by the source data. No CVSS score is provided in the input data. The update is available and should be applied to affected systems.
